claim: The record treats the installation of the specialised commercial courts as unknown (o4, grade D), has x2 tell the lawyer to check whether the court is installed, and says in k51 that the commercial section's former reach (b22) may still govern. The installation text exists: Executive Decree 23-53 of 14 January 2023 creates twelve specialised commercial courts 'across the whole national territory' and gives each its area of judicial councils; the courts were installed from 23 January 2023 (tier-3 report, see below). For any petition drafted now, the Law 22-13 art. 13 condition is met everywhere, so the article 536 bis subjects have left the ordinary court; only cases filed before installation stay with the commercial section.

source.what: Executive Decree 23-53 of 14 January 2023 fixing the territorial areas of the specialised commercial courts, JO no. 2 of 15 January 2023, pp. 18-19 (arts. 1-3 and annex: 12 courts, Béchar to Oran, covering every judicial council). Installation: Radio Algérie, 23 January 2023, https://news.radioalgerie.dz/ar/node/20519 (tier 3): «يشرف رؤساء المجالس القضائية عبر التراب الوطني, ابتداء من اليوم الاثنين, على تنصيب المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة».

quoteArabic: المادة 2 : يحدد عدد المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة باثنتي عشرة (12) محكمة عبر كامل التراب الوطني، تحدد دوائر اختصاصها الإقليمي طبقا للملحق المرفق بهذا المرسوم. المادة 3 : تزود المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة للجزائر ووهران وقسنطينة بمقرات خاصة. تنعقد كل محكمة من المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة الأخرى بالمحكمة المحددة بموجب قرار من وزير العدل، حافظ الأختام، التابعة للمجلس القضائي الذي تقع في دائرة اختصاصه مقر المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة.
consequence: Settle o4 for current petitions: the specialised commercial courts are installed and cover the whole territory. x2 should send an article 536 bis dispute to another court (a question of subject-matter jurisdiction, art. 36), not tell the lawyer to check installation. The b22 reading ('before installation the commercial section keeps all commercial disputes') should apply only to cases already filed before installation (Law 22-13 art. 13 ¶2). The exit's message should name the prior conciliation of art. 536 bis 4, whose record of non-conciliation is required on pain of inadmissibility, even if the step itself belongs to another module.

claim: Territory rule t5 says only that the code's general and special territorial rules apply to the specialised commercial court (536 bis 1). That court's area is set by decree, as a list of judicial councils, and is not the ordinary court's area. Executive Decree 26-133 of 30 March 2026 replaced the annex: 25 courts, new areas, installed gradually, with the courts already installed covering the new areas until the new courts are installed, and pending cases staying put. A lawyer who follows t5 alone may file before the wrong specialised court, or before the specialised court of the old area.

source.what: Executive Decree 26-133 of 30 March 2026 amending and completing Executive Decree 23-53, JO no. 27 of 12 April 2026, pp. 10-11 (arts. 2, 2 bis, 2 bis 1, 2 bis 2 and the annex of 25 courts). The installation of the 13 new courts is reported by the Ministry of Justice through awras.com, 24 September 2026 (tier 3): «أعلنت وزارة العدل ... تنصيب 13 محكمة تجارية متخصصة جديدة، وذلك بمقرات المجالس القضائية».

quoteArabic: المادة 2 : يحدد عدد المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة بخمس وعشرين (25) محكمة عبر كامل التراب الوطني، تحدد دوائر اختصاصها الإقليمي طبقا للملحق المرفق بهذا المرسوم. ... المادة 2 مكرر 1 : يمتد الاختصاص الإقليمي للمحاكم التجارية المتخصصة المنصبة قبل صدور هذا المرسوم، إلى دائرة الاختصاص الإقليمي للمحاكم التجارية المتخصصة الجديدة إلى حين تنصيب هذه الأخيرة. المادة 2 مكرر 2 : تبقى الإجراءات القائمة أمام المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة المختصة قبل صدور هذا المرسوم، من اختصاص نفس هذه الجهة القضائية دون تحويلها إلى المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة الجديدة، المختصة إقليميا.
consequence: t5 should say that the code's territorial rules point to a place, and that the specialised commercial court competent for that place is the one whose annex lists its judicial council (Decree 23-53 as amended by Decree 26-133). Example: a company dispute whose seat is in Médéa now goes to the specialised commercial court of Blida (annex no. 6), not to a court in Médéa. The ledger and the store hold neither decree.

target: k3, k1, o6, k54, k15, o7, court_has_section_for_matter, x3
claim: k3 is answered 'searchedNotFound' and o6 says the list of sections is not in the texts. Organic Law 22-10 on judicial organisation, art. 21, lists the court's sections (civil, misdemeanours, contraventions, urgent matters, family, minors, social, real estate, maritime, commercial). It lets the court president reduce the number of sections or divide them into chambers by order. A court may therefore have merged sections by the president's order, which is neither 'section created' nor 'sections not created' in the sense of cpca 32 ¶5. So the slot court_has_section_for_matter and the reading of o7 rest on an incomplete picture. Art. 28 also allows specialised courts for commercial, real-estate and labour disputes to sit within a judicial council.

source.what: Organic Law 22-10 of 9 June 2022 on judicial organisation, JO no. 41 of 16 June 2022, p. 8, arts. 21, 23, 24 and 28.

quoteArabic: المادة 21 : تشمل المحكمة الأقسام الآتية : – القسم المدني، – قسم الجنح، – قسم المخالفات، – القسم الاستعجالي، – قسم شؤون الأسرة، – قسم الأحداث، – القسم الاجتماعي، – القسم العقاري، – القسم البحري، – القسم التجاري. غير أنه، يمكن رئيس المحكمة، بعد استطلاع رأي وكيل الجمهورية، تقليص عدد الأقسام أو تقسيمها إلى فروع حسب أهمية وحجم النشاط القضائي. يفصل كل قسم في القضايا المعروضة عليه، ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك. ... المادة 28 : يمكن أن يضم المجلس القضائي محاكم متخصصة تفصل في المنازعات ذات الطابع التجاري والعقاري والعمالي.
consequence: k3 becomes 'applies' (sections may be split into chambers by the president's order), and k1/o6/k54 cite art. 21 for the list of sections, including a maritime section and an urgent-matters section. The section question should allow for a court whose president has merged sections: the section to name is the one the president's order assigns, which the lawyer must check. o7 should take this text into account.

claim: n7 and o10 say the texts do not settle which court hears a civil servant's dispute, and ex18 still proposes the social section for a civil servant's reinstatement claim. Law 90-11 on labour relations, art. 3, takes civil servants, contract agents of public bodies and administrations of the State, wilayas and communes, and staff of public administrative establishments out of that law and puts them under special texts. Read with cpca 800, which the record cites, the employment-contract reading behind cpca 500 does not reach them. The record proposes the wrong section, and arguably the wrong court order, for a common case.

source.what: Law 90-11 of 21 April 1990 on labour relations, JO no. 17 of 25 April 1990, p. 562, art. 3 (also in the article store as labour-relations 3 ¶1, which the record does not cite).

quoteArabic: المادة 3 : يخضع المستخدمون المدنيون والعسكريون التابعون للدفاع الوطني والقضاة والموظفون والأعوان المتعاقدون في الهيئات والإدارات العمومية في الدولة والولايات والبلديات ومستخدمو المؤسسات العمومية ذات الطابع الإداري، لأحكام تشريعية وتنظيمية خاصة.
consequence: When worker_is_public_servant is yes, the section rule should not propose the social section. It should cite labour-relations 3 with cpca 800 and route the case to the administrative-court exit, warning for a contract agent of a public industrial or commercial body, whom art. 3 does not name. ex18 should expect no social section.

claim: The social alternative and x3 fire only on the request kinds 'wages' and 'reinstatement'. Cpca 500 gives the social section exclusive jurisdiction over the termination of employment contracts, social-security and retirement disputes, and collective agreements, which the record quotes (b11, b12) but never uses in a rule. Case: a dismissed worker sues only for compensation for abusive dismissal (requests: damages), or an insured person contests a CNAS decision (requests: payment). The record proposes the civil section and gives no warning; n4 covers only a wage debt. In a court without sections it again proposes civil, where cpca 32 ¶5 excepts social cases.

source.what: Law 08-09 of 25 February 2008, Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure, JO no. 21 of 23 April 2008, p. 41, art. 500 (unchanged by Law 22-13 per the ledger).

quoteArabic: يختص القسم الاجتماعي اختصاصا مانعا في المواد الآتية : ... 2 - تنفيذ وتعليق وإنهاء عقود العمل والتكوين والتمهين، ... 6 - منازعات الضمان الاجتماعي والتقاعد، 7 - المنازعات المتعلقة بالاتفاقات والاتفاقيات الجماعية للعمل.
consequence: The social alternative and x3 should fire on the nature of the dispute, for example on a slot asking whether the claim arises from an employment, training or apprenticeship relationship, or is a social-security or retirement dispute, and not only on two request kinds. A damages or payment claim by a worker against an employer should not fall to the civil section by default.

target: court.section (realEstate alternative on partition), b18, ex8, o5
claim: The record sends every 'partition' request to the real-estate section, with no warning (ex8), on cpca 512 ¶10. The code puts estate claims (دعاوى التركة) in the family-section chapter (Book II, Title I, Chapter I, Section 7: arts. 498-499, where the family judge also orders the protective measures over the estate). Art. 40 ¶3 lists inheritance matters with divorce, custody and maintenance. Case: heirs ask for the partition of an estate that holds a flat and bank savings. The record proposes the real-estate section silently, and cites neither 498 nor 499. o5's 'why' mentions estates, but no reading, warning or slot follows from it.

source.what: Law 08-09 (CPCA), JO no. 21 of 23 April 2008, p. 41, arts. 498 and 499, under «الفصل الأول في قسم شؤون الأسرة / القسم السابع في التركة».

quoteArabic: القسم السابع في التركة. المادة 498 : يؤول الاختصاص في دعاوى التركة إلى المحكمة التي يقع فيها موطن المتوفى، حتى وإن وجدت بعض أملاك التركة خارج دائرة الاختصاص الإقليمي لهذه المحكمة، ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك. المادة 499 : يجوز لقاضي شؤون الأسرة، وعن طريق الاستعجال، أن يتخذ جميع التدابير التحفظية، لاسيما الأمر بوضع الأختام، أو تعيين حارس قضائي لإدارة أموال المتوفى إلى غاية تصفية التركة.
consequence: Ask whether a partition is the partition of an estate. If it is, warn that the family-section chapter (498-499) and the real-estate section (512 ¶10) compete. Add an estate-partition example. Also note in t3/t4 that art. 498 sends estate claims to the court of the deceased's domicile, not the court where the property lies.

claim: The family alternative fires only on the request kinds divorce, tatliq, khul, maintenance, custody, custody_transfer, visitation, housing and guardianship. The family-section chapter also covers disputes over the dowry and over the furnishings of the marital home (cpca 426 ¶7 and ¶9), proof of marriage and filiation, and kafala (cpca 423 ¶4-5, quoted in b9 but used by no rule). Case: a divorced wife sues for her unpaid deferred dowry (requests: payment), or for the return of her household goods (متاع بيت الزوجية). The record proposes the civil section and gives no warning.

source.what: Law 08-09 (CPCA), JO no. 21 of 23 April 2008, p. 36, art. 423 ¶4-5 and art. 426 ¶7 and ¶9, in the family-section chapter.

quoteArabic: المادة 426 : تكون المحكمة مختصة إقليميا : ... 6 - في موضوع متاع بيت الزوجية بمكان وجود المسكن الزوجي، ... 8 - في موضوع المنازعة حول الصداق بمكان موطن المدعى عليه، ... المادة 423 : ... 3 - دعاوى إثبات الزواج والنسب، 4 - الدعاوى المتعلقة بالكفالة،
consequence: The family alternative should not depend only on those request kinds. It should also fire when the dispute is between spouses or former spouses, or concerns dowry, household goods, proof of marriage or filiation, or kafala, for example through a 'family relationship' slot. t4 should add the territorial rules of 426 ¶7 and ¶9.

target: court.section (commercial_lease alternative), n3, o2, ex5, ex15
claim: For every commercial lease the record proposes the commercial section, and n3/o2 weigh only the commercial section against the real-estate section. The Commercial Code sends one common commercial-lease dispute to neither: where the landlord agrees to renew but the parties disagree on rent, duration or terms, they must appear before the president of the court where the building lies, under the summary procedure, whatever the rent. This holds for leases governed by the pre-2005 regime (art. 187 bis 1 keeps renewal of leases concluded before Law 05-02 under the old rules). For such a dispute the record names the wrong judge and the wrong procedure.

source.what: Ordinance 75-59 (Commercial Code), art. 195 ¶1 and ¶5, and art. 187 bis 1 (Law 05-02), read in the project article store (commercial-code 195, 187 مكرر 1); the Official Journal page (JO no. 101 of 1975) was not opened, so this is a lead to be checked there, including for later amendments of art. 195.

quoteArabic: اذا وافق المؤجر على تجديد الايجار وكان أمر الخلاف يتعلق ببدل الايجار أو المدة أو الشروط اللاحقة أو بمجموع هذه العناصر، وجب على الطرفين الحضور أمام رئيس المحكمة المختصة، التي يكون موقع العمارة تابعا لها ، وذلك مهما كان مبلغ الايجار والذي يقوم بالبت فيها حسب الاجراء المقرر في قضايا الامور المستعجلة. ... يفصل رئيس المحكمة في الدعوى بموجب أمر مسبب.
consequence: n3, or a new boundary, should flag the renewal-terms dispute of a commercial lease concluded before Law 05-02 (or with a contractual right of renewal) as belonging to the court president under the summary procedure, outside the section rule.
